problems.definition: App logs user out repeatedly, preventing continuous use.
Push notifications for new tickets or chats never arrive on device.
Videos and photos repeat same content; new media only after reinstall.
Attachments cannot be downloaded, showing an unavailable error.
Closing tickets requires many steps, making the process arduous.
Search function always returns a server error, never providing results.
Selecting a different inbox redirects to an incorrect inbox.
Live chat (Beacon) functionality is absent from the mobile app.
Cannot view customer details or custom metadata within tickets on mobile.
Workflow automation tools are not available in the mobile application.
Application crashes frequently during normal usage.
Cannot delete a conversation; delete option is absent.
